object_scope_note: HS 2022 subheading 2503.00 is a SCOPED SUBSET of the general 'sulfur' concept: it excludes sublimed/precipitated/colloidal sulphur (those are 2802.00). This record establishes the CLASSIFICATION identity/boundary only, not a chemical property of the concept and not any trade quantity.
claim_scope: Under the WCO Harmonized System 2022 (H6), heading 25.03 / subheading 2503.00 = 'Sulphur of all kinds; other than sublimed, precipitated and colloidal sulphur'; the excluded forms (sublimed/precipitated/colloidal) are 2802.00 = 'Sulphur; sublimed or precipitated, colloidal sulphur'. Establishes the international HS classification identity and the 2503/2802 exclusion boundary ONLY. Says nothing about any national tariff code, any trade quantity/value, or any chemical property.
